risks.title: Increase in raw material and supply chain costs
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the introduction of Item 1A. The strength of language (challenges) and context (inflation, higher raw material, packaging, co-manufacturing, and logistics costs) indicate significant concern. This risk is weighted by its direct impact on gross margin.

risks.title: Impairment of intangible assets
risks.score_rationale: The $60.9 million impairment loss is a major component of the period's results. The strength of language is high due to the significance of the loss. This risk is weighted by its direct impact on net income and asset value.

risks.title: Integration and acquisition-related costs
risks.score_rationale: Integration expenses related to the OWYN acquisition increased by $20.3 million. Language intensity is moderate but the cost is significant. This risk is weighted by its impact on operating expenses and profitability.

risks.title: Decline in gross margins
risks.score_rationale: Gross margin decreased by 220 basis points, primarily due to unfavorable raw material costs and lower margins from OWYN. The impact on profitability is direct and quantifiable. This risk is weighted by its significant impact on financial performance.

risks.title: Decline in certain business segments (Atkins)
risks.score_rationale: The Atkins segment is experiencing continued distribution declines. Language intensity is moderate (continued declines). This risk is weighted by its impact on overall revenue growth.

risks.title: Increase in general and administrative expenses
risks.score_rationale: G&A expenses increased by 20.2%, primarily due to integration costs and employee-related expenses. Language intensity is moderate but the increase is significant. This risk is weighted by its impact on operating profitability.
